# Learn with Anil PYQs (learnwithanil.in)

> Previous year question papers (PYQs) of Indian government recruitment exams with answers from the official final keys, a short explanation for every question, and online practice: question-by-question practice with a timer, timed tests, subject-wise (sectional) tests and topic-wise quizzes. Made by Jupudi Anil Kumar, a civil-services educator in Hyderabad.

Key facts:
- 7,733 questions from the official papers of 11 exams: APPSC Group-II, APPSC Group-I, UPSC CAPF (AC), UPSC EPFO (APFC, EO/AO, PA), SSC CGL, TS Police SI, TS Police Constable, TGPSC HMWSSB Manager (Engineering), APPSC AMVI (Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector), TGPSC AMVI (Assistant Motor Vehicles Inspector), APPSC Executive Officer Grade-III (Endowments).
- Answers come only from the official keys published by the recruiting body (APPSC, TSLPRB/TGPRB, UPSC, TSPSC/TGPSC). For a few old APPSC papers (Group 1 2019 and 2023, Group 2 2019) APPSC printed only the correct answer; there the other three options are written by Learn with Anil and labelled.
- Languages: English with Telugu for APPSC, TS Police and TGPSC exams; English with Hindi for UPSC exams.
- Free: every question and its correct answer from the official key are public on the paper, subject and question pages, with the explanations of the first 10 questions of each paper, and a daily question of the day.
- PYQ Pass: ₹45 once for 12 months, covering everything on the site: every previous paper of every exam (and exams added later) with every explanation, practice in the app, timed tests, sectionals and study tools, every mock test series and the study books. Nothing else is sold.
- UPSC EPFO Mock Test Series: 10 mock tests, coming soon, included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/upsc-epfo/mock-test.html
- Mission CGL – SSC CGL Mock Test Series (Tier-I & Tier-II): 13 full-length mock tests (Tier-I Mock 1 and Tier-II Mock 1 are available now; the other 11 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ssc-cgl/mock-test.html
- Mission Khaki – TS Police SI Prelims 2026 Test Series: 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 is available now; Mocks 2–10 are coming soon), included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ts-police-si/mock-test.html
- Mission Khaki – Constable: TS Police Constable Prelims Test Series: 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 (free) is available now; the other 9 mocks are coming soon), included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/ts-police-constable/mock-test.html
- Bahubali Test Series (APPSC Group 2 Mains): 24 full-length tests, included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/bahubali-test-series/
- Not affiliated with APPSC, TSLPRB, UPSC, TGPSC or any recruiting body.

## Study material (PDF books)
- [APPSC Group-II Micro-Syllabus 2026 (Notification 37/2026), English Medium](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/notes/): 47-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 9 subjects · 267 sub-topics · 1,004 PYQs mapped · 112 current affairs (2025–26). Chapters: Indian History; Geography: World, India and Andhra Pradesh; Indian Society; Current Affairs; Mental Ability; Social and Cultural History of Andhra Pradesh; Indian Constitution; Indian and Andhra Pradesh Economy; Science and Technology. Included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. Free sample chapter (PDF, shareable): https://learnwithanil.in/LearnWithAnil-APPSC-Group-2-Micro-Syllabus-Free-Sample.pdf
- [Andhra Pradesh Economy: Crisp Notes 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/notes/): 45-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar. Chapters: Structure and Growth of the AP Economy; Public Finances of Andhra Pradesh; Central Assistance and Externally Aided Projects; Agriculture, Rural Credit and Agricultural Marketing; Horticulture, Livestock, Fisheries, Forests and Minerals; Industrial Growth, Policies and Corridors; Services Sector, IT, Electronics and Communications; Practice Questions. Included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass.
- [ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థ: క్రిస్ప్ నోట్స్ 2026-27 (తెలుగు మాధ్యమం)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/notes/): 46-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar. Chapters: ఏపీ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థ నిర్మాణం, వృద్ధి; ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థ; కేంద్ర సహాయం, విదేశీ సహాయ ప్రాజెక్టులు; వ్యవసాయం, గ్రామీణ రుణం, వ్యవసాయ మార్కెటింగ్; ఉద్యాన, పశుసంవర్ధక, మత్స్య, అటవీ, ఖనిజ రంగాలు; పారిశ్రామిక వృద్ధి, విధానాలు, కారిడార్లు; సేవల రంగం, ఐటీ, ఎలక్ట్రానిక్స్, కమ్యూనికేషన్లు; ప్రాక్టీస్ ప్రశ్నలు. Included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass.
- [Science and Technology for APPSC Group-I and Group-II Mains, 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/notes/): 179-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 16 chapters · 31 photos · 60 Group-I + 83 Group-II PYQs. Chapters: Science, Technology and Innovation: Policies, Institutions and Missions; Emerging Technologies and Nanotechnology; ICT, Digital India and Cyber Security; Space Technology; Defence Technology; Nuclear Technology and India's Nuclear Policy; Energy: Demand, Efficiency, Security and Conventional Sources; Renewable and Clean Energy; Ecology, Ecosystems and Biodiversity; Natural Resources, Forests, Mining and Food Security; Pollution and Waste Management; Climate Change, Global Environmental Issues and Sustainable Development; Environmental Laws, Impact Assessment and Disaster Management; Biotechnology; Human Health, Diseases and Public Health; Intellectual Property Rights in Science and Technology; Group-I Mains: Previous Questions. Included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass.
- [Hindu Philosophy & Temple System for APPSC EO Grade-III, 2026-27 (English Medium)](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-endowment-officer/notes/): 167-page PDF by Jupudi Anil Kumar, 10 chapters · 24 meme breaks · 291 Paper II PYQs (2023 & 2026). Chapters: Ramayanam; Mahabharatham; Bhagavatham and the Puranas; Temple Agamas and Worship; Hindu Festivals and Classical Arts; Vedic Culture; Philosophies, Cults and Gurus; Hindu Family: Structure, Adoption and Succession; The A.P. Endowments Act, 1987: Administration, Income and the Executive Officer; Land Records and Endowment Lands. Included in the ₹45 PYQ Pass. Free sample chapter (PDF, shareable): https://learnwithanil.in/LearnWithAnil-EO-Grade-3-Hindu-Philosophy-Temple-System-Free-Sample.pdf

## About
- [About Jupudi Anil Kumar](https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/about/): civil-services educator, 1,000+ hours of teaching for UPSC, APPSC and TGPSC aspirants.
- [Fund Learn with Anil](https://learnwithanil.in/funders.html): a one-person project built to be student-friendly and to democratise learning, with the goal of 1 lakh PYQs of various government exams under one roof for ₹45; Anil needs help from funders, which in turn helps him help the students.
